title: Retail POC — Model selection, quantization, and prompt/pipeline tuning notes
context: Mid-market retail customer piloting on-prem / dedicated Redwood deployment. 4-week POC to validate latency, cost, and quality before recommending Dedicated vs Hosted with private tenancy.
customer_goals: Latency: 95th percentile < 180ms for short queries (<= 64 tokens); < 350ms for long sessions where streaming is acceptable.
Cost: token-unit cost target equivalent to < $0.004 per generated token at scale (discounted target for dedicated reserved capacity).
Quality: relevance + safety for product retrieval; attribute extraction accuracy > 88% (F1 on held prompt set); minimize hallucinations in product info responses.
Ops: easy rollback, A/B rollout, and deterministic behavior for business-critical checkout flows.
constraints_environment: Private deployment inside customer VPC; GPU fleet mixed A10 and RTX6000 (8x); NVMe-backed KV cache on local nodes; max context 4096 tokens; typical turns 1-6 messages; average prompt length 40 tokens; PII scrubbed upstream; no external telemetry leave VPC; logs exported to customer SIEM.
model_candidates: Llama-2 7B (FP16 / int8 / fused): small/fast baseline, low latency, may miss domain nuances.
Mistral-Instruct 7B or Falcon-7B-Instruct (NF4 / AWQ): mid-size balance of quality and latency, good for classification/extraction.
Llama-3 13B (quantized to 4-bit GPTQ/AWQ): higher quality for longer completions and multi-step reasoning.
RedSafe-2k (internal safety-tuned reranker): used as a final classifier/reranker to reduce hallucinations.
quantization_experiments: Methods: GPTQ (4-bit, per-channel), AWQ (2/4-bit with per-token scaling), SmoothQuant, NF4.
Targets: prioritize 4-bit GPTQ/AWQ on 13B to fit memory on 8x A10 pool and reduce KV memory pressure.
Measurements: for each model+quant measure p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, peak GPU memory (model+KV), and quality delta vs FP16 baseline using automated metrics and a 200-sample human blind eval.
Notes: for 7B compare int8 vs NF4 — int8 may hit faster kernel paths on A10; NF4 often smaller but kernel maturity varies.
prompting_pipeline_tuning: Product-Extraction template: system instruction to extract attributes to strict JSON schema with examples; deterministic outputs (temperature 0.0) for structured outputs.
RAG pattern: prefix with top-k=3 retrieved docs; include provenance markers and a 'do-not-invent' instruction. Use mid-size generator for grounding.
Clarification-turn pattern: for ambiguous queries prompt model to ask one clarifying question instead of guessing.
Token budgeting: typical retrieval 3x150 tokens; allocate generation budget ~90 tokens to stay within a ~512 token pipeline average.
Consistency controls: temperature=0.0 + top_p=0.7 for structured extraction; temperature=0.2 for conversational output; force deterministic sampling for checkout-critical responses.
Post-processing: strict JSON schema validation; fallback to deterministic extractor if parse fails; add output-reranker classifier to pick among up to 3 candidates.
batching_and_caching_strategy: Prefix caching: enable KV-prefix caching for product descriptions and frequently requested SKU context; target cache hit rate > 40%.
Dynamic batching: test batch windows 1-8 ms in Dedicated; tune adaptive policy to meet throughput SLO with latency cap.
Micro-batching: fast-path immediate dispatch for <64 token requests; batch larger sessions for throughput efficiency.
evaluation_plan_and_metrics: Automatic metrics: attribute extraction F1, exact-match SKU canonicalization, normalized edit distance for short-field correction.
Human eval: 300-sample blind eval across retrieval + conversational answers; raters score factuality (0-3), relevance (0-3), and safety flags.
Regression tests: Redwood eval harness prompt set id RETAIL_POC_V1 runs nightly; alert if primary metric degrades > 3 points.
Perf tests: synthetic loadtests at 2x expected peak for 30 minutes to surface queuing/backpressure.
deployment_recommendations: Phase 0 (lab): run 7B int8 baseline on single A10 node; verify extraction accuracy and deterministic outputs.
Phase 1 (pilot): run Mistral-Instruct 7B (NF4) with KV caching and RAG; run quantized 13B on separate node for comparison.
Phase 2 (scale): if 13B 4-bit quality delta < 2% on F1 and memory fits, recommend 13B quantized as primary for complex queries and 7B for fast-path.
Fallbacks: if 13B unavailable route heavy queries to region-hosted Redwood model (hosted fallback) with metadata and graceful degradation.
open_questions_and_risks: Quantization toolchain parity: AWQ vs GPTQ quality differences are model-specific; validate for Mistral and Llama-3 variants.
Kernel support: verify NF4/AWQ kernel support on mixed A10/RTX6000 fleet; SRE to confirm runtime kernel fallbacks.
Safety tuning tradeoffs: how aggressive should RedSafe reranker be vs. potential UX friction from false positives?
Cost model assumptions: reserved capacity pricing assumed; update numbers if customer picks burst/spot.
short_checklist_week_1_2: Prepare prompt sets: 300 retrieval, 200 extraction, 100 long-form convo.
Convert Llama-3 13B to 4-bit GPTQ and AWQ; store artifacts in POC model registry.
Run automated perf bench across quant variants (p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, mem).
Run human eval blind test for top 3 variants and collect qualitative notes.
Implement deterministic extractor + output-reranker and sanity-check parse rates.
Validate prefix KV cache hit rates under synthetic traffic.
notes_to_implementation: Use Redwood runtime flags: --enable-prefix-cache and --batch-window-ms=4 for pilot; enable explicit kernel-selection logs for benchmarking.
Track experiments in Jira: RETAIL-POC-21X (bench), RETAIL-POC-22X (quant), RETAIL-POC-23X (eval); link results into Confluence RETAIL_POC_RESULTS_V1.
Maintain a small human-in-the-loop safety triage board for pilot days 1-3.
appendix_quick_reference:
Recommended prompt snippet (Product extraction): System: "You are a strict extractor. Output only valid JSON following schema {\"sku\":string,\"title\":string,\"brand\":string,\"price\":string,\"attributes\":{}}. Do not invent fields. If unknown, use null."
User: "Extract fields from the product page below. Page: <RETRIEVED_DOCS>"

Weekly metrics to report: p95 latency, avg cost per 1k tokens, extraction F1, cache hit rate, number of safety flags.
